edition_scope: Complete Bekker authorial printed-page range, including prefatory letter, across the combined scan and retained second-volume source. Combined scans 446/447 repeat pages 334/335; genuine printed pages 434/435 remain in the unchanged legacy witness. No codex-level paragraph mapping is invented.

quality_scope.fresh_limitations: Severe word and ligature errors remain, particularly on faint source pages. Exact source-confirmed unrelated readings, persistent systematic mark loss, and a scan381 line-order defect abstain from voting after finite reviewed remedies. The complete degraded alternatives remain raw; no word order or replacement text is invented. Source reviews establish qualified body coverage and do not certify lexical accuracy or a proofread critical text. Raw readings, held attempts, bounded comparison witnesses, and merged disagreements remain available.
quality_scope.historical_limitations: Unchanged historical primary rows still include confirmed editorial apparatus. The 545-page coverage claim does not classify every historical row as authorial text.

policy: Merge all independently retained readings. Exact word ties stay explicit in text and out of scalar analysis_text. Preserve every supplied raw reading; no arbitrary source preference or silent correction. Existing later-volume passages remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
reversal: Run scripts/ingest_photius_coverage.py --undo to remove the unchanged addition, then scripts/repair_photius_index.py --undo to recover the original full delivery.
